goal.decided: The user stacks tasks and has an AI work on them, the work resumes once the usage limit lifts, and the results are checked and taken in afterward. Once it's achieved, an AI stacks tasks and lets go, and afterward checks which tasks finished and which were given up, and takes their results in.

deliverables.name: The user stacks tasks and has an AI work on them, the work resumes once the usage limit lifts, and the results are checked and taken in afterward. Once it's achieved, an AI stacks tasks and lets go, and afterward checks which tasks finished and which were given up, and takes their results in.
The AI's aim with stacked tasks, and how well it gets there, is set down
An AI learns from the guide whether the plugin fits its work and how to stack tasks and take their results in
The AI learns what changed for it in each version of the plugin
The parts that run the stacked tasks, resume them after the limit, and report each task's end are drawn
The parts' modules and their interfaces show that they fit together
The cases that check the joined parts reach the AI's aim are written

decisions.decided: A queue stacked anew waits for the next time its start hour comes; a queue stacked again to carry on its unfinished tasks starts them at once.

decisions.about: How the runner knows a queue is carried on
decisions.decided: The stacker hands the runner no start for a queue stacked again to carry on its unfinished tasks, so the runner starts them at once.

decisions.about: A task carried on and its earlier waits
decisions.decided: A task carried on keeps none of its earlier waits, as its stops at the usage limit count from zero again.

decisions.about: A queue stacked again whose every task finished
decisions.decided: Stacking again a queue whose every task finished starts no runner and says that every task finished.

decisions.about: A check while tasks still run
decisions.decided: A check while the runner still carries tasks tells each task not yet ended as still running, beside the ends of the others.

deliverables.name: The runner stacks tasks, resumes each after the limit lifts, and reports which finished and which were given up
